items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Marie Dickerson. She just happened to be there and we had a nice little time reminiscing with each other.

ctx.x: eight months before I lost my third wife. After my retirement from the board of education in 1964, I stayed home to take care of my wife who was ill at the time. This is February, 1964, and that lasted until October '64, when she passed. After she passed, I took two or three trips to kind of get over my grieving. The first one I went to Chicago to visit my sister and then I came back. At that time it was near the holidays and I had a couple of gigs during the holidays. In the first part of January I wanted to go…
Marie Dickerson. She just happened to be there and we had a nice little time reminiscing with each other.
I didn't stay long but she was still there, she had been down there for some time before I got there.
